RENEWABLE ENERGY ACT 2011

RENEWABLE ENERGY (FEED-INAPPROVAL AND FEED-INTARIFF RATE)(AMENDMENT)

(NO. 2) RULES 2013

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 61(a) of the Renewable Energy Act 2011

[Act 725], the Sustainable Energy Development Authority Malaysia makes the following

rules:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Renewable Energy (Feed-In Approval and

Feed-in Tariff Rate) (Amendment) (No. 2) Rules 2013.

(2) These Rules are deemed to have come into operation on 28 March 2013.

Amendment of rule 19

2. The Renewable Energy (Feed-in Approval and Feed-in Tariff Rate) Rules 2011

[P.U. (A) 385/2011], which are referred to as the "principal Rules" in these Rules, are

amended in subrule 19(6) by deleting the words "and upon payment of the processing fee

as prescribed in the Second Schedule,".

Substitution of Second Schedule

3. The principal Rules are amended by substituting for the Second Schedule the

following Schedule:

(Subrules 4(1), 4A(3), 13A(2), 16(2), 18(1), and rule 24)
